Notes · 2026

Notes on land

A field is never empty. It is waiting for a reason.

I read the road before the parcel. The road decides more than the price does.

Water, access, the neighbours. The drawing comes last.

“It is because nothing stays that the world is lovely.”

Yoshida Kenkō · Essays in Idleness · c. 1330
Newer“You just divide up land and sell it, right?”
